title: Stop partial Coder progress messages to Merger; hand off only complete packages
outcome: Stop partial Coder progress messages to Merger; hand off only complete packages
acceptance: The Coder-to-Merger communication procedure permits a handoff only for a complete package ready for review, as Greg requested; routine test-progress and review-start notifications do not wake the Merger.
Intermediate Coder progress stays in the task record rather than being forwarded as a partial package to Merger.

The complete package identifies its scope, base and frozen input, evidence and actual review state without implying readiness that has not been achieved; this communication correction does not introduce a second Merger review.

The corrected rule is persisted in project memory and propagated to the operating procedure used by Coders and the Merger; a subsequent real handoff demonstrates that partial progress did not generate Merger notifications.
